dedupe_keys.name: argentina hydrocarbon and water ducts declared under resolution 319 93 oil gas product and water pipelines

description: This data set from the Argentine Secretariat of Energy maps the lines of ducts in Argentina, covering oil pipelines, gas pipelines, multi-product pipelines, water ducts and others, as declared each year by companies of the sector in sworn statements through the Planos Base system under Resolution 319/93. An instruction document linked from the record gives the requested attributes and technical specifications. The data set on the energy open data portal was last modified on 1 September 2026 and offers the lines as a CSV file and as a shapefile in EPSG:4326. The ministry geographic information page groups it with other shapefile and CSV layers, such as hydrocarbon installations registered under Resolution 318/2010, pumping stations of hydrocarbon transport and transport ducts, and older PDF thematic maps of hydrocarbon transport by region from 2017, and the SIG Energía viewer shows the layers on a map. Coverage is Argentina. Files are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: lines come from company declarations and their accuracy is not stated, and the regional PDF maps are static and older. Simulation uses are oil and gas pipeline network models and exposure of pipelines to floods, earthquakes and other hazards. Related records: data-argentina-enargas-gas-pipelines-compressor-stations covers the gas transport and distribution network from ENARGAS.
